vopSummary = {
  if (!vopCty.length) return null;
  const total = d3.sum(vopCty, (d) => d.vop_intld15);
  const live = d3.sum(vopCty.filter((d) => d.kind === "Livestock"), (d) => d.vop_intld15);
  return {total, livestockShare: total ? live / total : 0, top: vopCty[0].commodity};
}
// ---- picker metrics (static per load) ----
pickerMetricDefs = {
  const seq = (interp) => (vals) => d3.scaleSequential(d3.extent(vals), interp);
  return {
    [_lang(nbText.sections.b1.metrics.vop)]: {key: "vop", fmt: (v) => "I$ " + d3.format("~s")(v), scale: seq(d3.interpolateGreens)},
    [_lang(nbText.sections.b1.metrics.ndvi)]: {key: "ndvi", fmt: (v) => Math.round(v) + "%", scale: seq(d3.interpolateBrBG)},
    [_lang(nbText.sections.b1.metrics.ipc)]: {key: "ipc", fmt: (v) => "IPC " + v, scale: seq(d3.interpolateOrRd)},
    [_lang(nbText.sections.b1.metrics.rainOND)]: {key: "rainOND", fmt: (v) => Math.round(v) + " mm", scale: seq(d3.interpolateBlues)},
    [_lang(nbText.sections.b1.metrics.rainMAM)]: {key: "rainMAM", fmt: (v) => Math.round(v) + " mm", scale: seq(d3.interpolateBlues)},
  };
}
pickerMetrics = {
  const vop = await dbVop.query(`SELECT CAST(gaul1_code AS DOUBLE) AS g, SUM(vop_intld15) AS v FROM vop GROUP BY 1`);
  const ndvi = await dbNdvi.query(`
    WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(date) AS d FROM ndvi_county)
    SELECT CAST(gaul1_code AS DOUBLE) AS g, AVG(ndvi_pct_normal) AS v
    FROM ndvi_county WHERE date >= (SELECT d FROM latest) GROUP BY 1`);
  const ipc = await dbIpc.query(`
    WITH latest AS (SELECT county, MAX(reporting_date) AS d FROM ipc_county WHERE scenario_name = 'Current Situation' GROUP BY county)
    SELECT i.county AS c, MAX(i.max_phase) AS v
    FROM ipc_county i JOIN latest l ON i.county = l.county AND i.reporting_date = l.d
    WHERE i.scenario_name = 'Current Situation' GROUP BY 1`);
  const rain = await dbChirps.query(`
    SELECT period, CAST(gaul1_code AS DOUBLE) AS g, AVG(value_mean) AS v
    FROM chirps_county
    WHERE variable = 'PTOT' AND period IN ('OND', 'MAM') AND year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020
    GROUP BY 1, 2`);
  const byName = new Map(counties.map((d) => [countyNorm(d.county), +d.gaul1_code]));
  const keep = new Set(counties.map((d) => +d.gaul1_code)); // canonical 47 only (no Ilemi)
  const only = (pairs) => new Map(pairs.filter((e) => keep.has(e[0])));
  const m = new Map();
  m.set("vop", only(vop.map((d) => [+d.g, d.v])));
  m.set("ndvi", only(ndvi.map((d) => [+d.g, d.v])));
  m.set("ipc", only(ipc.map((d) => [byName.get(countyNorm(d.c)), d.v]).filter((e) => e[0] != null)));
  m.set("rainOND", only(rain.filter((d) => d.period === "OND").map((d) => [+d.g, d.v])));
  m.set("rainMAM", only(rain.filter((d) => d.period === "MAM").map((d) => [+d.g, d.v])));
  return m;
}
pickerExport = counties.map((c) => ({county: c.county,
  vop_intld: pickerMetrics.get("vop").get(+c.gaul1_code) ?? null,
  ndvi_pct_normal_latest: pickerMetrics.get("ndvi").get(+c.gaul1_code) ?? null,
  ipc_latest: pickerMetrics.get("ipc").get(+c.gaul1_code) ?? null,
  ond_mean_mm: pickerMetrics.get("rainOND").get(+c.gaul1_code) ?? null,
  mam_mean_mm: pickerMetrics.get("rainMAM").get(+c.gaul1_code) ?? null}))
dbNapr = DuckDBClient.of({
  napr: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/knbs_napr_county_production.parquet"),
  afa_rice: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/afa_rice.parquet"),
})
dbLive = DuckDBClient.of({live: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/knbs_napr_livestock.parquet")})
dbProd = DuckDBClient.of({prod: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/knbs_napr_livestock_products.parquet")})

naprCty = dbNapr.query(`
  SELECT item, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, val, pdf_page FROM (
    SELECT crop AS item, county, year, production_t AS val, pdf_page FROM napr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT crop AS item, county, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, production_t AS val, CAST(pdf_page AS INT) AS pdf_page FROM afa_rice
  ) t
  WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}' AND val IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY item, year`)
naprNatl = dbNapr.query(`
  SELECT item, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, SUM(val) AS natl FROM (
    SELECT crop AS item, year, production_t AS val FROM napr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT crop AS item, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, production_t AS val FROM afa_rice
  ) t GROUP BY item, year`)
liveCty = dbLive.query(`SELECT species AS item, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, head AS val, pdf_page FROM live WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}' ORDER BY item, year`)
liveNatl = dbLive.query(`SELECT species AS item, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, SUM(head) AS natl FROM live GROUP BY species, year`)
prodProdCty = dbProd.query(`SELECT product AS item, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, value_ksh AS val, pdf_page FROM prod WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}' ORDER BY item, year`)
prodProdNatl = dbProd.query(`SELECT product AS item, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, SUM(value_ksh) AS natl FROM prod GROUP BY product, year`)

// ---- produce machinery v3 (multiselect groups, year range, CR view trio) ----
prodAll = [
  ...naprCty.map((d) => ({group: "Crops", item: d.item, year: d.year, val: d.val, unit: "t"})),
  ...liveCty.map((d) => ({group: "Livestock", item: d.item, year: d.year, val: d.val, unit: "head"})),
  ...prodProdCty.map((d) => ({group: "Products", item: d.item, year: d.year, val: d.val, unit: "KSh"})),
]
prodNatlAll = new Map([
  ...naprNatl.map((d) => [`Crops|${d.item}|${d.year}`, d.natl]),
  ...liveNatl.map((d) => [`Livestock|${d.item}|${d.year}`, d.natl]),
  ...prodProdNatl.map((d) => [`Products|${d.item}|${d.year}`, d.natl]),
])
// option objects for the multiselect: {group, item, label}
prodItemsAvail = {
  const inGroups = prodAll.filter((d) => prodGroups.includes(d.group));
  const seen = new Map();
  for (const d of inGroups) seen.set(`${d.group}|${d.item}`, {group: d.group, item: d.item, label: `${d.item} · ${d.group.toLowerCase().replace(/s$/, "")}`});
  return [...seen.values()].sort((a, b) => a.group.localeCompare(b.group) || a.item.localeCompare(b.item));
}
prodDefaultPick = {
  // per-group top-6 by latest-year value keeps the default legible
  const picks = [];
  for (const g of prodGroups) {
    const rows = prodAll.filter((d) => d.group === g && d.val > 0);
    if (!rows.length) continue;
    const latest = d3.max(rows, (d) => d.year);
    const byItem = d3.rollup(rows.filter((d) => d.year === latest), (v) => d3.sum(v, (d) => d.val), (d) => d.item);
    const top = [...byItem].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 6).map((e) => e[0]);
    picks.push(...prodItemsAvail.filter((o) => o.group === g && top.includes(o.item)));
  }
  return picks;
}
prodPctFmt = (v) => v == null ? null : v === 0 ? 0 : v >= 1 ? +v.toFixed(1) : +v.toPrecision(2)
prodRows = {
  const y0 = Math.min(prodYearFrom, prodYearTo), y1 = Math.max(prodYearFrom, prodYearTo);
  const keys = new Set(prodPick.map((o) => `${o.group}|${o.item}`));
  const pct = prodMode.startsWith("%");
  return prodAll
    .filter((d) => prodGroups.includes(d.group) && keys.has(`${d.group}|${d.item}`) && d.year >= y0 && d.year <= y1)
    .map((d) => {
      const natl = prodNatlAll.get(`${d.group}|${d.item}|${d.year}`);
      return {...d,
        value: pct ? (natl ? d.val / natl * 100 : null) : d.val,
        unitShown: pct ? "% of national" : d.unit};
    })
    .filter((d) => d.value != null);
}
prodUnitFor = (g) => prodMode.startsWith("%") ? "% of national"
  : g === "Crops" ? "tonnes" : g === "Livestock" ? "head" : "KSh (value)"
prodFmtVal = (v) => prodMode.startsWith("%") ? prodPctFmt(v) + "%" : formatNumCompactShort()(v)
prodGroupsShown = () => [...new Set(prodRows.map((d) => d.group))]

// Bars: side-by-side years within each commodity (variant-B composite x),
// one panel per commodity group (units differ)
prodViewBars = () => {
  if (!prodRows.length) return noDataPlaceholder();
  const years = [...new Set(prodRows.map((d) => d.year))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const yearColor = new Map(years.map((y, i) => [y, paletteRange(Math.max(years.length, 3))[i]]));
  const panels = prodGroupsShown().map((g) => {
    const rows = prodRows.filter((d) => d.group === g);
    const items = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => d.item))]
      .sort((a, b) => d3.sum(rows.filter((r) => r.item === b), (r) => r.value) - d3.sum(rows.filter((r) => r.item === a), (r) => r.value));
    const present = new Set(rows.map((d) => `${d.item}|${d.year}`));
    const xDomain = items.flatMap((it, i) => {
      const cats = years.filter((y) => present.has(`${it}|${y}`)).map((y) => `${it}|${y}`);
      if (i < items.length - 1) cats.push(`__sep_${i}`);
      return cats;
    });
    const midYear = (it) => {
      const ys = years.filter((y) => present.has(`${it}|${y}`));
      return ys[Math.floor((ys.length - 1) / 2)];
    };
    const labelTicks = xDomain.filter((k) => {
      if (!k || k.startsWith("__")) return false;
      const [it, y] = k.split("|");
      return midYear(it) === +y;
    });
    const plot = Plot.plot({
      height: 330, width: 900, marginLeft: 62, marginBottom: 55,
      x: {domain: xDomain, ticks: labelTicks, tickFormat: (k) => wrapTickLabel(k.split("|")[0], 12), label: null, padding: 0.12},
      y: {label: prodUnitFor(g), grid: true, tickFormat: formatNumCompactShort()},
      color: {domain: years, range: years.map((y) => yearColor.get(y)), legend: true, label: "Year", tickFormat: "d"},
      marks: [
        Plot.barY(rows, {x: (d) => `${d.item}|${d.year}`, y: "value", fill: "year",
          channels: {Commodity: "item", Year: {value: (d) => String(d.year), label: "Year"},
            Value: {value: (d) => `${prodFmtVal(d.value)} ${prodMode.startsWith("%") ? "" : d.unit}`, label: "Value"}},
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Commodity: true, Year: true, Value: true}}}),
        Plot.ruleY([0]),
      ],
    });
    return html`<div><div class="ke-panel-lbl">${g}</div>${plot}</div>`;
  });
  return html`<div>${panels}</div>`;
}

prodViewLines = () => {
  if (!prodRows.length) return noDataPlaceholder();
  const panels = prodGroupsShown().map((g) => {
    const rows = prodRows.filter((d) => d.group === g);
    const items = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => d.item))];
    const colors = paletteRange(items.length);
    const years = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => d.year))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const missing = items.flatMap((it) => years
      .filter((y) => !rows.some((r) => r.item === it && r.year === y))
      .map((y) => ({item: it, year: y})));
    // never join 1-2 point series into a line (reads as a 0-to-value jump);
    // ∅ markers live at the TOP frame, never at y=0 (blank ≠ zero, V2-02)
    const lineItems = new Set(items.filter((it) => rows.filter((r) => r.item === it).length >= 3));
    const plot = Plot.plot({
      height: 320, width: 900, marginLeft: 62, marginRight: 140,
      x: {ticks: years, tickFormat: "d", label: null},
      y: {label: prodUnitFor(g), grid: true, tickFormat: formatNumCompactShort()},
      color: {domain: items, range: colors, legend: true},
      marks: [
        Plot.lineY(rows.filter((d) => lineItems.has(d.item)),
          {x: "year", y: "value", stroke: "item", strokeWidth: 1.8}),
        Plot.dot(rows, {x: "year", y: "value", fill: "item", r: 3, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.5,
          channels: {Commodity: "item", Year: {value: (d) => String(d.year), label: "Year"},
            Value: {value: (d) => `${prodFmtVal(d.value)} ${prodMode.startsWith("%") ? "" : d.unit}`, label: "Value"}},
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Commodity: true, Year: true, Value: true}}}),
        Plot.text(missing, {x: "year", frameAnchor: "top", text: () => "∅", dy: 8, fontSize: 11, fill: "#aaa",
          title: (d) => `${d.item} ${d.year}: not reported — not zero`}),
        Plot.ruleY([0]),
      ],
    });
    return html`<div><div class="ke-panel-lbl">${g}</div>${plot}</div>`;
  });
  return html`<div>${panels}</div>`;
}

// Treemap: single-year snapshot (END year, with ≤year fallback per item)
prodViewTree = () => {
  if (!prodRows.length) return noDataPlaceholder();
  const yEnd = Math.max(prodYearFrom, prodYearTo);
  const groups = prodGroupsShown();
  const cellW = Math.floor((900 - 12 * (groups.length - 1)) / groups.length);
  const tipHost = html`<div class="cr-treemap-tip" role="tooltip"></div>`;
  const buildOne = (g) => {
    const byItem = d3.group(prodRows.filter((d) => d.group === g), (d) => d.item);
    const snapshot = [];
    for (const [, rows] of byItem) {
      const valid = rows.filter((r) => r.year <= yEnd && r.val > 0).sort((a, b) => b.year - a.year);
      if (valid.length) snapshot.push(valid[0]);
    }
    if (!snapshot.length) return html`<div></div>`;
    const items = snapshot.map((d) => d.item);
    const colorBy = new Map(items.map((it, i) => [it, paletteRange(items.length)[i]]));
    // treemap AREA is always the absolute value (share of the group total),
    // whatever the Units toggle shows elsewhere — the tooltip carries the %
    const root = d3.hierarchy({children: snapshot}).sum((d) => d.val).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
    d3.treemap().size([cellW, 300]).paddingInner(2)(root);
    const groupTotal = root.value || 1;
    const leafEls = root.leaves().map((leaf) => {
      const w = leaf.x1 - leaf.x0, h = leaf.y1 - leaf.y0;
      const fill = colorBy.get(leaf.data.item) || "#999";
      const valueText = formatNumCompactShort()(leaf.data.val) + " " + leaf.data.unit;
      const tipText = `${leaf.data.item} (${leaf.data.year}): ${valueText} · ${(100 * leaf.value / groupTotal).toFixed(1)}% of shown ${g.toLowerCase()}`;
      const textFill = treemapTextColor(fill);
      const halo = textFill === "#fff" ? "#000" : "#fff";
      const lay = treemapTextLayout(w, h, leaf.data.item.length, valueText.length, 14);
      return svg`<g transform="translate(${leaf.x0}, ${leaf.y0})">
        <rect class="cr-treemap-cell" data-tip="${tipText}" width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="${fill}" stroke="#999" stroke-width="0.75"><title>${tipText}</title></rect>
        ${lay.showLabel ? svg`<text x="6" y="${lay.labelSize + 2}" fill="${textFill}" stroke="${halo}" stroke-width="${Math.max(0.8, lay.labelSize * 0.12)}" stroke-opacity="0.6" paint-order="stroke" style="font-size:${lay.labelSize}px;pointer-events:none">${leaf.data.item}</text>` : svg`<g/>`}
        ${lay.showValue ? svg`<text x="6" y="${lay.labelSize + 2 + lay.valueSize + 3}" fill="${textFill}" stroke="${halo}" stroke-width="${Math.max(0.7, lay.valueSize * 0.1)}" stroke-opacity="0.5" paint-order="stroke" style="font-size:${lay.valueSize}px;pointer-events:none">${valueText}</text>` : svg`<g/>`}
      </g>`;
    });
    const svgEl = svg`<svg width="${cellW}" height="300" style="display:block;background:#fafafa">${leafEls}</svg>`;
    return html`<div style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:top">
      <div style="font-size:11.5px;color:#444;text-align:center;height:20px;line-height:20px">${g} — ${yEnd} (or latest ≤ ${yEnd})</div>${svgEl}</div>`;
  };
  const grid = html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px">${groups.map(buildOne)}</div>`;
  const wrap = html`<div>${tipHost}${grid}</div>`;
  wrap.querySelectorAll(".cr-treemap-cell").forEach((r) => {
    const t = r.getAttribute("data-tip");
    r.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => { tipHost.textContent = t; tipHost.style.display = "block"; });
    r.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => { tipHost.style.left = `${e.clientX + 14}px`; tipHost.style.top = `${e.clientY + 14}px`; });
    r.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { tipHost.style.display = "none"; });
  });
  return wrap;
}

prodViewTable = () => {
  if (!prodRows.length) return noDataPlaceholder();
  const rows = prodRows.map((d) => ({Group: d.group, Commodity: d.item, Year: d.year,
    Value: prodMode.startsWith("%") ? prodPctFmt(d.value) : Math.round(d.value),
    Unit: d.unitShown}));
  return html`<div>${dataTable(rows, {rows: 18})}
    <div class="plot-footer-row">${downloadCsvBtn(rows, `${county}_produce_table`)}</div></div>`;
}

// ---- VoP views (treemap default + bars; CR pattern) ----
vopViewBars = () => {
  const rows = vopCty.slice().sort((a, b) => b.vop_intld15 - a.vop_intld15).slice(0, 14);
  if (!rows.length) return noDataPlaceholder(`No exposure data for ${county}.`);
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 60 + rows.length * 26, width: 720, marginLeft: 150,
    x: {label: "value of production (constant I$)", tickFormat: formatNumCompactShort(), grid: true},
    y: {domain: rows.map((d) => d.commodity), label: null},
    color: {domain: ["Crop", "Livestock"], range: [PALETTE.impact.crop, PALETTE.impact.livestock], legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(rows, {x: "vop_intld15", y: "commodity", fill: "kind", rx: 2,
        channels: {Commodity: "commodity", Kind: "kind",
          Value: {value: (d) => "I$ " + formatNumCompactShort()(d.vop_intld15), label: "Value"}},
        tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Commodity: true, Kind: true, Value: true}}}),
      Plot.ruleX([0]),
    ],
  });
}
vopViewTree = () => {
  if (!vopCty.length) return noDataPlaceholder(`No exposure data for ${county}.`);
  const tipHost = html`<div class="cr-treemap-tip" role="tooltip"></div>`;
  const total = d3.sum(vopCty, (d) => d.vop_intld15);
  const kindColor = {Crop: d3.scaleSequential([0, 1], d3.interpolateGreens), Livestock: d3.scaleSequential([0, 1], d3.interpolateOranges)};
  const items = vopCty.map((d) => d.commodity);
  const colorBy = new Map(vopCty.map((d, i) => [d.commodity,
    d.kind === "Crop" ? d3.interpolateGreens(0.35 + 0.5 * (i % 5) / 5) : d3.interpolateOranges(0.35 + 0.5 * (i % 5) / 5)]));
  const root = d3.hierarchy({children: vopCty}).sum((d) => d.vop_intld15).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
  d3.treemap().size([860, 420]).paddingInner(2)(root);
  const leafEls = root.leaves().map((leaf) => {
    const w = leaf.x1 - leaf.x0, h = leaf.y1 - leaf.y0;
    const fill = colorBy.get(leaf.data.commodity) || "#999";
    const valueText = "I$ " + formatNumCompactShort()(leaf.value) + ` · ${(100 * leaf.value / total).toFixed(1)}%`;
    const tipText = `${leaf.data.commodity} (${leaf.data.kind}): ${valueText}`;
    const textFill = treemapTextColor(fill);
    const halo = textFill === "#fff" ? "#000" : "#fff";
    const lay = treemapTextLayout(w, h, leaf.data.commodity.length, valueText.length, 14);
    return svg`<g transform="translate(${leaf.x0}, ${leaf.y0})">
      <rect class="cr-treemap-cell" data-tip="${tipText}" width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="${fill}" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1"><title>${tipText}</title></rect>
      ${lay.showLabel ? svg`<text x="6" y="${lay.labelSize + 2}" fill="${textFill}" stroke="${halo}" stroke-width="${Math.max(0.8, lay.labelSize * 0.12)}" stroke-opacity="0.6" paint-order="stroke" style="font-size:${lay.labelSize}px;pointer-events:none">${leaf.data.commodity}</text>` : svg`<g/>`}
      ${lay.showValue ? svg`<text x="6" y="${lay.labelSize + 2 + lay.valueSize + 3}" fill="${textFill}" stroke="${halo}" stroke-width="${Math.max(0.7, lay.valueSize * 0.1)}" stroke-opacity="0.5" paint-order="stroke" style="font-size:${lay.valueSize}px;pointer-events:none">${valueText}</text>` : svg`<g/>`}
    </g>`;
  });
  const svgEl = svg`<svg width="860" height="420" style="display:block;background:#fafafa;max-width:100%">${leafEls}</svg>`;
  const legend = html`<div style="font-size:12px;color:#555;margin-top:4px"><span style="color:${PALETTE.impact.crop};font-weight:700">■</span> crops · <span style="color:${PALETTE.impact.livestock};font-weight:700">■</span> livestock · cell area = share of the county's agricultural value</div>`;
  const wrap = html`<div>${tipHost}${svgEl}${legend}</div>`;
  wrap.querySelectorAll(".cr-treemap-cell").forEach((r) => {
    const t = r.getAttribute("data-tip");
    r.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => { tipHost.textContent = t; tipHost.style.display = "block"; });
    r.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => { tipHost.style.left = `${e.clientX + 14}px`; tipHost.style.top = `${e.clientY + 14}px`; });
    r.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { tipHost.style.display = "none"; });
  });
  return wrap;
}
naprCtyFull = dbNapr.query(`
  SELECT crop, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, production_t, area_ha, value_ksh FROM (
    SELECT crop, county, year, production_t, area_ha, value_ksh FROM napr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT crop, county, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, production_t, area_ha, CAST(value_ksh AS DOUBLE) AS value_ksh FROM afa_rice
  ) t
  WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
  ORDER BY crop, year`)
prodEvtCrops = {
  const col = prodEvtVar.id;
  const latestVal = new Map();
  for (const d of naprCtyFull) {
    if (d[col] == null) continue;
    const cur = latestVal.get(d.crop);
    if (!cur || d.year > cur.year) latestVal.set(d.crop, {year: d.year, v: d[col]});
  }
  return [...latestVal.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1].v - a[1].v).map((e) => e[0]);
}
prodEvtDefault = {
  const latest = d3.max(naprCtyFull, (d) => d.year);
  const byItem = d3.rollup(naprCtyFull.filter((d) => d.year === latest && d.production_t > 0),
    (v) => d3.sum(v, (d) => d.production_t), (d) => d.crop);
  return [...byItem].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 5).map((d) => d[0]);
}
prodEvtRowsAll = {
  const col = prodEvtVar.id;
  return naprCtyFull
    .filter((d) => prodEvtPick.includes(d.crop) && d[col] != null)
    .map((d) => ({crop: d.crop, year: d.year, value: d[col], unit: prodEvtVar.unit}));
}
prodEvtYears = d3.range(2019, 2025)
prodEvtBars = () => {
  const rows = prodEvtRowsAll;
  if (!rows.length) return noDataPlaceholder(`No ${prodEvtVar.label} series for ${county}.`);
  const crops = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => d.crop))];
  const colors = paletteRange(crops.length);
  const ymax = d3.max(rows, (d) => d.value);
  const missing = crops.flatMap((c) => prodEvtYears
    .filter((y) => !rows.some((r) => r.crop === c && r.year === y))
    .map((y) => ({crop: c, year: y})));
  // grouped bars (V2-60): x axis = harvest years, crops side-by-side within
  // each year. The background carries the LAG-SHIFTED driving seasons —
  // behind year Y sit OND(Y−1), left, and MAM(Y), right — never Y's own
  // short rains (harvest-lag rule). Hover any band for its source season.
  const bgSns = phaseDefs[bgDriver].seasons ?? ["OND", "MAM"];
  const zOnd = bgSns.includes("OND") ? zSeries(bgDriver, "OND") : new Map();
  const zMam = bgSns.includes("MAM") ? zSeries(bgDriver, "MAM") : new Map();
  const bgRows = bgMode === "Off" ? [] : prodEvtYears.map((y) => ({
    year: y, zo: zOnd.get(y - 1) ?? null, zm: zMam.get(y) ?? null}));
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    height: 380, width: 860, marginLeft: 62, marginRight: 8,
    fx: {domain: prodEvtYears, tickFormat: "d", label: null},
    x: {domain: crops, axis: null},
    y: {label: prodEvtVar.unit, grid: true, nice: true, tickFormat: formatNumCompactShort()},
    color: {domain: crops, range: colors, legend: true},
    marks: [
      // full-facet wash = OND(Y−1), the season that grew most of year Y's crop
      Plot.rect(bgRows.filter((d) => d.zo != null), {fx: "year", y1: () => 0, y2: () => ymax,
        fill: (d) => bgFill(d.zo), fillOpacity: 0.55,
        title: (d) => `OND ${d.year - 1} (the short rains BEFORE the ${d.year} harvest): ${categoryOf(bgDriver, d.zo)} — ${d.zo.toFixed(1)} sd`}),
      // thin top band = MAM(Y), the harvest year's own long rains
      Plot.rect(bgRows.filter((d) => d.zm != null), {fx: "year", y1: () => ymax * 0.93, y2: () => ymax,
        fill: (d) => bgFill(d.zm), fillOpacity: 0.9,
        title: (d) => `MAM ${d.year} (the harvest year's long rains): ${categoryOf(bgDriver, d.zm)} — ${d.zm.toFixed(1)} sd`}),
      Plot.barY(rows, {fx: "year", x: "crop", y: "value", fill: "crop",
        stroke: "#777", strokeWidth: 0.4,
        channels: {Crop: "crop", Year: {value: (d) => String(d.year), label: "Harvest year"},
          Value: {value: (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.value)} ${d.unit}`, label: prodEvtVar.label},
          Rains: {value: (d) => {
            const t = tercByYear("OND").get(d.year - 1);
            return `OND ${d.year - 1}: ${t ? tercWord[t] : "no data"} (county rainfall tercile)`;
          }, label: "Preceding short rains"}},
        tip: {format: {fx: false, x: false, y: false, fill: false, Crop: true, Year: true, Value: true, Rains: true}}}),
      Plot.text(missing, {fx: "year", x: "crop", frameAnchor: "top", text: () => "∅", dy: 8, fontSize: 11, fill: "#888",
        title: (d) => `${d.crop} ${d.year}: not reported by KNBS — not zero`}),
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
    ],
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend({outlines: false})}
    <div style="font-size:12px;color:#555">${md`${_lang(nbText.sections.b3.prodLegend)}`}</div></div>`;
}

prodEvtLines = () => {
  const rows = prodEvtRowsAll;
  if (!rows.length) return noDataPlaceholder(`No ${prodEvtVar.label} series for ${county}.`);
  const crops = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => d.crop))];
  const colors = paletteRange(crops.length);
  const ymax = d3.max(rows, (d) => d.value);
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    height: 380, width: 860, marginLeft: 62, marginRight: 140,
    x: {domain: [2018.5, 2024.5], ticks: prodEvtYears, tickFormat: "d", label: null},
    y: {label: prodEvtVar.unit, grid: true, tickFormat: formatNumCompactShort()},
    color: {domain: crops, range: colors, legend: true},
    marks: [
      // the background is LAG-SHIFTED (bgMarksHarvest): behind year Y sit
      // OND(Y−1) and MAM(Y) — the seasons that grew the harvest, never Y's
      // own short rains (harvest-lag rule)
      ...bgMarksHarvest({y1: 0, y2: ymax, years: prodEvtYears}),
      Plot.lineY(rows, {x: "year", y: "value", stroke: "crop", strokeWidth: 1.8}),
      Plot.dot(rows, {x: "year", y: "value", fill: "crop", r: 3.5, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.6,
        channels: {Crop: "crop", Year: {value: (d) => String(d.year), label: "Year"},
          Value: {value: (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.value)} ${d.unit}`, label: prodEvtVar.label}},
        tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Crop: true, Year: true, Value: true}}}),
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
    ],
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend({outlines: false})}</div>`;
}

// "Vs rainfall" (V2-15 phase 1): harvest value against the PRECEDING short
// rains — the county's own rainfall, the section's tercile grammar,
// lag-correct by construction. Labelled dots; a pattern check, never a fit.
prodEvtVsDriver = () => {
  const rows = prodEvtRowsAll;
  if (!rows.length) return noDataPlaceholder(`No ${prodEvtVar.label} series for ${county}.`);
  const rainOnd = hsRainAnomPct("OND");
  const tOnd = tercByYear("OND");
  const pts = rows.map((d) => ({...d, x: rainOnd.get(d.year - 1) ?? null,
    t: tOnd.get(d.year - 1) ?? null})).filter((d) => d.x != null);
  if (!pts.length) return noDataPlaceholder("No rainfall record for the preceding seasons.");
  const crops = [...new Set(pts.map((d) => d.crop))];
  const colors = paletteRange(crops.length);
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    height: 400, width: 760, marginLeft: 70, marginRight: 130, grid: true,
    x: {label: "preceding short rains — OND of the year before (% vs 1991–2020 normal)"},
    y: {label: prodEvtVar.unit, tickFormat: formatNumCompactShort()},
    color: {domain: crops, range: colors, legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "#bbb"}),
      Plot.dot(pts, {x: "x", y: "value", fill: "crop", r: 6, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.7,
        channels: {Crop: "crop", Harvest: {value: (d) => String(d.year), label: "Harvest year"},
          Rains: {value: (d) => `OND ${d.year - 1}: ${d.x >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(d.x)}% vs normal${d.t ? ` · ${tercWord[d.t]}` : ""}`, label: "Preceding short rains"},
          Value: {value: (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.value)} ${d.unit}`, label: prodEvtVar.label}},
        tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Crop: true, Harvest: true, Rains: true, Value: true}}}),
      Plot.text(pts, {x: "x", y: "value", text: (d) => String(d.year), dy: -11, fontSize: 9.5, fill: "#555"}),
    ],
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}<div style="font-size:12px;color:#555">${md`${_lang(nbText.sections.b3.prodVsDriverNote)}`}</div></div>`;
}

prodEvtTable = () => {
  const rows = prodEvtRowsAll;
  if (!rows.length) return noDataPlaceholder(`No ${prodEvtVar.label} series for ${county}.`);
  const rainOnd = hsRainAnomPct("OND");
  const tOnd = tercByYear("OND");
  const t = rows.map((d) => ({Crop: d.crop, "Harvest year": d.year,
    [prodEvtVar.label]: Math.round(d.value),
    "Preceding short rains (OND of yr before)": (() => {
      const tc = tOnd.get(d.year - 1), r = rainOnd.get(d.year - 1);
      return tc ? `${tercWord[tc]}${r != null ? ` (${r >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(r)}% vs normal)` : ""}` : "no data";
    })()}));
  return html`<div>${dataTable(t, {rows: 16})}
    <div class="plot-footer-row">${downloadCsvBtn(t, `${county}_production_events_table`)}</div></div>`;
}
dbGesi = DuckDBClient.of({
  gesi: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/gesi_v2.parquet"),
})
gesiAll = dbGesi.query(`SELECT code, sub, label, county, kenya, county_value AS v FROM gesi`)
gesiSeries = {
  const clamp01 = (x) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  const norm = countyNorm(county);
  const byInd = d3.group(gesiAll, (d) => d.code + "|" + (d.sub ?? ""));
  const out = [];
  for (const [key, recs] of byInd) {
    const vals = recs.map((r) => r.v).filter((x) => x != null);
    if (vals.length < 20) continue;
    const min = d3.min(vals), max = d3.max(vals), span = (max - min) || 1;
    const median = d3.median(vals);
    const cRec = recs.find((r) => countyNorm(r.county) === norm);
    const r0 = recs[0];
    const label = r0.label + (r0.sub ? ` — ${r0.sub}` : "");
    const dots = recs.filter((r) => r.v != null).map((r) => ({
      county: r.county, v: r.v, pos: clamp01((r.v - min) / span),
      sel: countyNorm(r.county) === norm}));
    out.push({code: r0.code, sub: r0.sub, indicator: label, kenya: r0.kenya, n: vals.length,
      min, max, median, cv: cRec ? cRec.v : null,
      rank: cRec ? vals.filter((x) => x > cRec.v).length + 1 : null,
      posK: clamp01((r0.kenya - min) / span), posMed: clamp01((median - min) / span), dots});
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => a.code.localeCompare(b.code) || (a.sub || "").localeCompare(b.sub || ""));
}
gesiExport = gesiSeries.map((s) => ({indicator: s.indicator, code: s.code, sub: s.sub,
  county: s.cv, kenya: s.kenya, rank: s.rank, n: s.n, min: s.min, median: s.median, max: s.max}))
dbFaostat = DuckDBClient.of({
  faostat_detrended: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/faostat_detrended.parquet"),
})
faostatDet = dbFaostat.query(`
  SELECT crop, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, value, trend, anomaly, pct_anom
  FROM faostat_detrended
  ORDER BY crop, year`)
cropList = [...new Set(faostatDet.map((d) => d.crop))].sort()
cropAnom = faostatDet.filter((d) => d.crop === cropSel && d.anomaly != null)
cropJoin = cropAnom.map((d) => {
  const dr = driverSeasonal.find((x) => x.year === d.year);
  return {year: d.year, anomaly: d.anomaly, pct: d.pct_anom, driver: dr ? dr.v : null};
}).filter((d) => d.driver != null)
cropStat = {
  const n = cropJoin.length, xs = cropJoin.map((d) => d.driver), ys = cropJoin.map((d) => d.anomaly);
  const r = d3.mean(xs.map((x, i) => (x - d3.mean(xs)) * (ys[i] - d3.mean(ys)))) /
            (d3.deviation(xs) * d3.deviation(ys)) * n / (n - 1);
  const t = r * Math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r * r));
  return {n, r, t, sig: Math.abs(t) >= 2.0};
}
seasMean = (mons, col) => d3.rollups(drivers.filter((d) => mons.includes(d.month) && d[col] != null),
  (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d[col]), (d) => d.year).map(([year, v]) => ({year, v}))
pearson = (rows, a, b) => { const A = rows.map((d) => d[a]), B = rows.map((d) => d[b]), n = rows.length,
  mA = d3.mean(A), mB = d3.mean(B);
  return d3.sum(A.map((x, i) => (x - mA) * (B[i] - mB))) / Math.sqrt(d3.sum(A.map((x) => (x - mA) ** 2)) * d3.sum(B.map((x) => (x - mB) ** 2))); }
ensoIod = {
  const e = new Map(seasMean([10, 11, 12], "nino34_anom_noaa").map((d) => [d.year, d.v]));
  const i = seasMean([10, 11, 12], "dmi_hadisst");
  return i.filter((d) => e.has(d.year)).map((d) => ({year: d.year, enso: e.get(d.year), iod: d.v}));
}
ensoIodR = pearson(ensoIod, "enso", "iod")
ensoWnp = {
  const e = new Map(seasMean([3, 4, 5], "nino34_anom_noaa").map((d) => [d.year, d.v]));
  const w = seasMean([3, 4, 5], "wnp_std_mam");
  return w.filter((d) => e.has(d.year)).map((d) => ({year: d.year, enso: e.get(d.year), wnp: d.v}));
}
ensoWnpR = pearson(ensoWnp, "enso", "wnp")
zscore = (rows, col) => { const v = rows.filter((d) => d.year >= 1991 && d.year <= 2020).map((d) => d[col]).filter((x) => x != null);
  const m = d3.mean(v), s = d3.deviation(v); return (d) => d[col] == null ? null : (d[col] - m) / s; }
combined = {
  const zE = zscore(drivers, "nino34_anom_noaa"), zI = zscore(driversCoal, "dmi"), zW = zscore(drivers, "wnp_std_mam");
  const rows = driversCoal.filter((d) => d.year >= 2010).flatMap((d) => [
    {date: new Date(d.date), driver: "ENSO (Niño 3.4)", z: zE(d)},
    {date: new Date(d.date), driver: "IOD (DMI)", z: zI(d)},
    {date: new Date(d.date), driver: "Western-V (WNP)", z: zW(d)}]);
  return rows.filter((d) => d.z != null);
}
tApproxP = (t, df) => {
  const z = Math.abs(t) * (1 - 1 / (4 * df)) / Math.sqrt(1 + (t * t) / (2 * df));
  const p = 2 * (1 - 0.5 * (1 + erf(z / Math.SQRT2)));
  return Math.max(1e-6, Math.min(1, p));
}
erf = (x) => {
  const s = x < 0 ? -1 : 1; x = Math.abs(x);
  const a1 = 0.254829592, a2 = -0.284496736, a3 = 1.421413741, a4 = -1.453152027, a5 = 1.061405429, p = 0.3275911;
  const t = 1 / (1 + p * x);
  const y = 1 - (((((a5 * t + a4) * t) + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * Math.exp(-x * x);
  return s * y;
}
corrSeasonCode = corrSeasonPick.includes("OND") ? "OND" : "MAM"
corrByCounty = {
  const wnpByYear = new Map(seasMean([3, 4, 5], "wnp_std_mam").map((d) => [d.year, d.v]));
  const driverOf = (r) => corrDriverPick.startsWith("ENSO") ? r.roni_conc
    : corrDriverPick.startsWith("IOD") ? r.dmi_conc
    : (wnpByYear.get(r.year) ?? null);
  const byCty = d3.group(outlookBase.filter((r) => r.season === corrSeasonCode), (r) => r.gaul1_code);
  const out = new Map();
  for (const [gaul, rows] of byCty) {
    const pts = rows.map((r) => ({x: driverOf(r), y: r.anomaly_pct}))
      .filter((d) => d.x != null && d.y != null);
    if (pts.length < 20) continue;
    const r = pearson(pts, "x", "y");
    const n = pts.length;
    const t = r * Math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r * r));
    out.set(+gaul, {r, n, p: tApproxP(t, n - 2)});
  }
  return out;
}
corrExport = counties.map((c) => {
  const s = corrByCounty.get(+c.gaul1_code);
  return {county: c.county, season: corrSeasonCode, driver: corrDriverPick,
    r: s ? +s.r.toFixed(3) : null, n: s ? s.n : null, p: s ? +s.p.toFixed(4) : null};
})
dotCropList = [...new Set(naprCty.map((d) => d.item))].sort()
dotPlotRows = {
  const prod = naprCty.filter((d) => d.item === dotCrop && d.val > 0);
  if (prod.length < 3) return [];
  const med = d3.median(prod, (d) => d.val);
  // season window: the SELECTED crop's calendar where present, else the
  // county-level rule, else annual (R2 fix — was county-wide only)
  const cropNorm = (x) => String(x).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, "");
  const own = calCty.filter((r) => r.stage === "Planting" &&
    (cropNorm(r.crop).includes(cropNorm(dotCrop)) || cropNorm(dotCrop).includes(cropNorm(r.crop))));
  const calRows = own.length ? own : calCty.filter((r) => r.stage === "Planting");
  const period = calRows.some((r) => r.season === "Short rains") && !calRows.some((r) => r.season === "Long rains")
    ? "OND"
    : calRows.some((r) => r.season === "Long rains") && !calRows.some((r) => r.season === "Short rains")
    ? "MAM" : "annual";
  const series = chirpsYearlyAll.filter((d) => d.period === period && d.value != null);
  const sorted = series.map((d) => d.value).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const pctOf = (v) => sorted.length ? (d3.bisectLeft(sorted, v) / sorted.length) * 100 : null;
  const byYear = new Map(series.map((d) => [d.year, d.value]));
  return prod.map((d) => {
    const rain = byYear.get(d.year);
    return rain == null ? null : {year: d.year, rainPct: pctOf(rain), prodPct: d.val / med * 100, period};
  }).filter(Boolean);
}
